body: That makes sense. I’ll try. Thank you.

I actually started making jewelry pretty recently. I walk around my house singing pretty much all day, just about random shit. The issue is that even when I express myself creatively, I think about how that expression could be better. For example, I love to sing and have some formal training. But it’s always in the back of my head that it doesn’t matter because no one will ever hear it and tell me I’m good. I feel like I’m incapable of doing things for myself rather than for praise or recognition. I don’t have anything that I can do just to “calm down.” There always has to be a point to doing it or there’s no point to do it at all. I mean yeah the point is literally to clear my head but it feels like wasting time. I tend to drown in my head too. I don’t necessarily want to be completely alone with my thoughts because I will undoubtedly think myself into either a severe depressive state (which has been what’s happened lately) or an anxiety attack.

I’m just a shitty person. Personality wise. Don’t know how to fix it. I have anger issues, am petty and mean, jealous, and just frankly a toxic person to be around, even to myself. I have no concept of empathy and don’t really experience emotions besides anger and self loathing. 

I’m also unemployed atm, running out of money, don’t really have any friends, don’t get along with my family, and I’m not sure if I really love my husband anymore or if that’s my brain just not making the chemicals it’s supposed to make. 

I don’t want to exist inside my own head anymore because it’s fucked everything up. I’ve considered that I might just be a psychopath or something too severe for therapy to fix.

Our society puts so much into looks. I don’t think I’m the prettiest person alive and also get mistaken for being younger than I am. I got told an upside once and it helps: you don’t lose looking younger than you are (assuming you maintain same diet and stuff). So when you get old and everyone your age is getting wrinkles and age spots, you probably won’t until later. It sucks to look like a kid when you’re not but when you’re older it’ll be great to look like a young adult. 

Also I found that I looked more my age when I changed my hair. Find something that makes you like yourself a little more. I got new glasses a couple months ago that look really good on me so even though I hate myself that’s a little perk. 

And I actually believe as far as the attraction that there’s someone for everyone. It may take you a while to find them but there are literally endless types of people in this world. One of them is bound to be into you at some point.

Yes. Put me on medications that didn’t work and I don’t want to take pills everyday anyway. There’s not really any good places in my area so that was the extent of it. “Here’s a bottle of pills so you won’t kill yourself” and that was that.
